# Design by CC

> Portfolio of Choong Ching Teo (CC) — Lead Product Designer based in Singapore. 12+ years as a hands-on IC across B2B SaaS, AI-native products, and enterprise platforms. Currently sole designer at Trustana, building a PIM and AI data enrichment platform processing 30K+ SKUs per month for enterprise retailers across APAC and the Middle East.

## About

CC is a Lead Product Designer based in Singapore. End-to-end IC across research, design systems, prototyping in the live codebase, and shipping. Specializes in B2B SaaS, AI product design, enterprise workflows, design systems, and zero-to-one product building.

Career: Trustana (Lead Product Designer, Mar 2021 – Present), Saleswhale (Senior Product Designer, YC S16, 2019–2020), Rakuten Viki (UX Designer, 2015–2019, 40M+ monthly viewers), AsiaRooms (UX Designer, 2013–2015), Aleph-Labs (UI/UX Designer for OCBC / UOB / ANZ digital banking, 2011–2012).
